SELECT sc.id, sc.response_text, sc.routed_model, sc.input_tokens, sc.output_tokens, sc.cost_usd, sc.retrieved_kb_ids, sc.intent
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT *
  FROM semantic_cache
  WHERE $3::boolean
    AND query_embedding <=> $1::vector < 0.15
    AND language = $2
    AND expires_at > now()
  ORDER BY query_embedding <=> $1::vector
  LIMIT 1
) sc ON true
LIMIT 1;
